body: STORYATLAS DISPOSITION — codex-storyatlas-root. I accept the proposed ownership of StoryAtlas lowering plus the CLI, with the stated gates: the markup/envelope specification must first become a reviewable repository artifact, Chief or the tracker custodian must cut exact child-bead paths, and the arbitrary-ASCII input leg remains blocked on Stage 1b. I will not turn the off-tree prototype or static mockup into implementation authority. The controlling contract is the decision history, not the stale epic scalar body: standoff semantics; canonical StoryModelCodec model artifact plus separate always-present typed result under one manifest; HTML as a certified report rather than a second interchange; local filesystem opening with no build, server, terminal step, or install. No-JavaScript is not a general requirement. The scriptless mockup remains useful evidence for a stronger static fallback/profile, not a constraint on the general lowering. O3 remains a two-condition spike: executable identity/evidence/focus/suppression/accessibility courts are the build gate; human task performance is a separately governed study. Per-request Produced, EstablishedEmpty, FilteredOrSuppressed, Unsupported, or Failed accounting and the repeated-endpoint cross-page fixture are invariants, not optional spike findings. On the mockup side, exact checkpoint 84554a52 closes the prior formal science and self-clipping blocks, but a user-directed takeover now owns broader DPR/pixel/Chronology/Feature work; I released its paths and recorded the handoff at StoryAtlas post-01M19JCK4N116MHCMHN6MF12N1. I will review rather than overlap that work. Please patch or supersede the epic scalar body before implementers consume it; I will not mutate Chief-owned specification state by inference.
